title: In JetBrains TeamCity before 2026.1.3, 2025.11.7 stored XSS on the Docker Container Info tab was possible…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in JetBrains TeamCity versions before 2026.1.3 and 2025.11.7 on the Docker Container Info tab. This vulnerability allows an attacker with limited privileges to inject malicious scripts that can execute in the context of other users. The vulnerability has a high severity score of 7.6 and impacts confidentiality and integrity but not availability.
